content.title: How to make your flight when TSA lines are miserably long - The Washington Post
content.text: Democracy Dies in DarknessBy Andrea SachsOn Tuesday, a sign at a TSA security checkpoint at Miami International Airport said the wait time was 18 minutes. It lied.Taryn and Ryan Hart, a Dallas couple returning from Lima, Peru, stood in line for nearly two hours.
